objective:
PROJECT RICKY — IMD SWARM PREPARATION

Develop a viral, sarcastic PulseChain meme-token project featuring Ricky, a fictional gangster in an expensive suit being escorted away by international police. The humor should be dark, instantly recognizable and crypto-native.

1. Research

Investigate the reference token 0x79FC0E1d3EC00d81E5423DcC01A617b0e1245c2B, relevant PulseChain news, competing meme tokens, liquidity, historical performance and community attention. Verify facts and distinguish confirmed information from allegations and speculation.

2. Brand and viral concept

Develop the strongest short name, ticker, narrative, slogans, character design and visual identity for Ricky. Prioritize psychological recognition, wordplay, sarcasm and repeatable memes. Check name and ticker availability before recommending them.

3. Tokenomics

Design fair, transparent tokenomics with 0% buy/sell tax as the baseline. Evaluate supply distribution, liquidity, creator allocation, locks, ownership concentration and sustainable revenue. Develop a satirical “Tax Fraud Burn” concept: fictional gangster humor around a transparent, verifiable on-chain burn mechanism, without actual tax evasion or misleading claims. Compare ETH and IMD pairing options and recommend the strongest setup.

4. IMD integration

Make the IMD network part of Ricky’s story. Explore agent-generated memes, community competitions and viral campaigns that create genuine engagement for both communities. Do not claim official endorsement or existing integrations without evidence.

5. Website and visual planning

Specify a premium, mobile-first website with strong gangster-style branding, tokenomics, verified contract details, social links, burn tracking and risk disclosures. Prepare the design direction, page structure, feature requirements, logo, avatar, banner and at least 12 original meme concepts.

6. X marketing

Prepare 21 ready-to-publish English posts for seven days, three per day, with hooks, punchlines, meme concepts, community challenges and a consistent narrative. No fake engagement, fabricated facts or guaranteed-profit claims.

7. Business and risk analysis

Assess realistic audience demand, organic growth, costs, revenue possibilities, liquidity requirements, security risks and legal obligations. Define measurable launch criteria and clear reasons to abandon the project if the opportunity is weak.

8. Ownership and dependencies

This project is commissioned by me. Aim for my ownership of all original project-specific concepts, branding, copy, designs and deliverables to the fullest extent legally possible. Check applicable IMD terms and third-party licenses. Identify any restrictions explicitly.

Define dependencies between every deliverable. The approved brand, verified facts and final tokenomics must become the source of truth for the later website, visuals, marketing and technical implementation. Flag unresolved decisions rather than guessing.

PHASE 1 — PREPARATION ONLY

Deliver the research, final recommendation, branding, tokenomics specification, website blueprint, visual concepts, marketing campaign, integration plan, risk assessment and launch checklist.

Do not create or deploy the token, write or deploy production smart contracts, build the live website, spend funds, create accounts or publish content yet.

PHASE 2 — LATER IMPLEMENTATION

After my explicit approval, a separate agent team must use the approved Phase 1 artifacts to build the website, create and independently review the token and smart contracts, produce final visual assets, configure integrations and prepare the launch. No deployment, funding or publication without my separate explicit approval.

Be skeptical, commercially focused and original. Optimize for genuine viral potential and sustainable participation, not hype alone. Clearly state what is verified, what is proposed and what remains uncertain.
